## 5. Session Information & In-Document Version Locking

> [!NOTE]
> Running `session_info.show()` permanently prints the exact Python interpreter version,
> OS platform, and all imported package versions directly into the report.

```{python}
try:
    import session_info
    session_info.show()
except ImportError:
    # Built-in zero-dependency fallback
    print(f"Python: {sys.version.split()[0]}")
    for name, mod in sorted(sys.modules.items()):
        if hasattr(mod, '__version__') and not name.startswith('_') and '.' not in name:
            print(f"  {name}: {mod.__version__}")
```
